test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"She may have told them the truth."

options.text: The truth may have told to them.
The truth may have been told to them.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "She may have told them the truth."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the truth" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "may have told" to "may have been told" (modal perfect passive).
 
• Add the preposition "to" followed by the indirect object "them."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The truth may have been told to them."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The truth may have told to them." – Incorrect verb form (missing "been").
 
• **Option 3: **"The truth may told them." – Incorrect verb form (missing "have been").
 
• **Option 4: **"The truth has been told." – Incorrect tense (present perfect passive instead of modal perfect passive).
